imagePrompt:
Shot on an iPhone 17 Pro Max, handheld, the main 48MP Fusion camera at 24mm equivalent and f/1.78, left on its default 24 megapixel output, Smart HDR 5 and Deep Fusion on, Photographic Style on Standard, everything left on automatic — exposure, white balance and focus all chosen by the phone rather than by a person. An ordinary photo taken on an ordinary phone.

A snapshot from a phone standing on his desk at chest height, about a metre from him, not quite level, nobody looking at its screen. Close framing: the frame's top edge cuts across his chin, so only his chin, neck, shirt collar, navy jumper, his two hands and the strap are in frame — no mouth, no nose, no eyes. The orthopaedic surgeon sits behind the desk and holds the strap out towards the phone at chest height with both hands. Behind him on the right, the X-ray lightbox hangs low on the wall at the height of his hands: the WHOLE lightbox is in frame, its full frame and both knee X-rays side by side glowing cool white, softly out of focus, with wall visible above and below it. Composed for a split screen: his chin, hands, the strap and the whole lightbox sit in the middle half of the tall frame; the top quarter is his chin and collar, the bottom quarter is the desk edge.

THE SAME PERSON exactly as in the attached subject reference image — tall and slightly stooped, broad square jaw, close white hair at the sides — unchanged in face, age and build, wearing this beat's own wardrobe per the wardrobe map. Wearing a blue-and-white fine-check button-down shirt, a navy v-neck jumper, a steel watch on the left wrist, in navy and denim blue.

THE SAME CONSULTING ROOM exactly as in the attached scene reference image — the X-ray lightbox with two knee X-rays on the back wall, the tall bookshelf of worn textbooks beside it, the desk under the left-hand window, the anatomical knee model on the desk — but seen from a COMPLETELY DIFFERENT CAMERA POSITION: on the desk itself at chest height, looking across the desk at the surgeon with the lightbox lowered on the back wall beside him at the height of his chest, where the reference was taken from the door, with every fixed feature stated on the correct screen side for this angle.

The product exactly as in the second and third attached product photos, held HORIZONTALLY, the long way from side to side, exactly as it lies in the second photo: a rigid matte-black polymer shell, its top edge rising into two matching rounded peaks of equal height either side of a concave notch, its bottom edge gently waisted, perfectly symmetrical left to right and never twisted, bent or warped; the lowercase grey stryde wordmark on the lower middle of the shell, directly beneath the notch, horizontal and readable, the front face square to the lens; one brushed chrome slide at each end of the shell, three dotted chevrons engraved on each, and no other metal anywhere; a black coarse-knit elastic band, about half as tall as the shell, closed into a short loop that runs from one slide round behind the shell to the other, the same short length as in the third photo, with two small matte-black plastic keeper loops on it. His right hand pinches the left end of the shell between thumb and fingers; his left hand is held flat, palm up, under the strap, with the band loop resting on his open palm. Size: the shell is about as wide as his hand is long from the wrist crease to the fingertips — neither toy-sized nor oversized.

Light: cool daylight from the window on his left, the lightbox behind him glowing white and rimming the hands and the strap's peaks, the front of the hands a stop darker with soft sensor noise.

THIS IS A FILE, NOT A PICTURE. Nobody framed it, nobody lit it, nobody chose the moment and nobody looked at it afterwards. It is an unremarkable photograph off a phone. Sharpness is uneven across the frame: one plane is in focus and everything in front of and behind it falls away, because the lens has one fixed aperture and nobody chose where to put the focus. Edges are soft rather than crisp, with faint compression mush in the shadows and detail thinning toward the corners. Nothing has been sharpened, cleaned up, separated from its background or arranged, and no part of the frame has been given more attention than any other part.

AVOID: no face above the chin, no mouth, no nose, no eyes, no wide shot, no whole desk, no strap held upright, no strap turned on its end, no vertical wordmark, no sideways wordmark, no twisted shell, no warped shell, no lopsided peaks, no extra chrome slides, no metal on the band, no chrome keeper loops, no buckles, no velcro, no long band, no band hanging down, no loose band tail, no open band, no second strap, no fingers over the wordmark, no fingers on the chrome slides, no lightbox cut off by the frame, no lightbox high on the wall, no phone in frame, no readable writing on the X-rays, no text on screen, no extra fingers, no fused fingers, no AI face, no plastic skin, no polished render, no advertising image, no studio lighting, no vignette, no film grain, no over-saturated colours
